Title: Generally Available: New Zealand North region added to Azure HDInsight
Services: Azure HDInsight on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Body.Content:
HDInsight is now generally available in New Zealand North. Azure HDInsight is a managed, full-spectrum, open-source analytics service in the cloud for enterprises. You can use open-source frameworks such as Hadoop, Apache Spark, Apache Hive, LLAP, Apache Kafka, and more.

Learn more.
